ingest_disposition.reason: No newer unconsumed packet was observed after the already-consumed 10:42Z Stop-hook packet; this is a direct-source refinement of the existing Stop-hook/deferred-causal-return handoff, not duplicate packet consumption.

semantic_atoms.what_it_does: The retrieval path already mints retrieval_id as UUID and persists it together with turn_id, episode_id, causal_id, session_id, user_id, generation, policy_version, query_hash, selected_memory_ids and related bounded receipt fields. The returned receipt exposes retrieval_id and query_sha256.

_apply_credit derives generation and causal_id from the exact retrieval row, records feedback with retrieval_id/causal_id/generation and de-duplicates by receipt_id. The default receipt_id hash includes retrieval_id, causal_id, generation, signal_class and the numeric credit value.

mensch_urteil already accepts a retrieval_id and resolves exactly SELECT * FROM retrieval_episodes WHERE retrieval_id=? before applying credit. This is a donor-local precedent proving exact retrieval binding does not require a second identity authority.

_kognition_richten_hook does not receive retrieval_id. It late-selects the newest same-session retrieval lacking modell:relevanz feedback, then reads candidate subject/value and the last user transcript text before calling the model and applying credit to that selected row.

forensic_result.reason: The donor already has a per-retrieval UUID plus turn/episode/causal/generation/query-hash envelope and an exact-ID feedback precedent. The missing contract is propagation and immutable input binding, not identity invention.
forensic_result.minimal_repair_direction: Create RetrievalRelevanceCandidate/v1 at retrieval/dispatch time from the existing retrieval identity envelope; never discover the origin later by session ordering.

input_binding_gap.finding: A deferred migration that carries retrieval_id but re-reads current durable_memory candidate text or simply takes the latest transcript user text at completion can still evaluate bytes different from those associated with the originating retrieval. retrieval_episodes stores query_hash and selected_memory_ids but the current Stop model path reconstructs model input later.
input_binding_gap.rule: The model result may be reduced only against the origin envelope and exact input digest it actually judged. A matching retrieval_id alone is necessary but not sufficient for deferred causal credit.

idempotency_refinement.finding: The visible _apply_credit default receipt hash includes the resulting numeric credit. Two different model outputs for the same retrieval/generation/signal_class therefore generate different receipt IDs at this layer. This pass did not establish a separate database UNIQUE(retrieval_id, signal_class) constraint, so Triggerword-4 must not assume value-dependent receipt hashing alone gives exactly-once model relevance admission.
idempotency_refinement.target_rule: A logical relevance job gets a stable job/admission identity independent of the returned credit value. Retries of the same logical job are idempotent; conflicting second results for the same accepted retrieval/generation/model-evidence slot are rejected or quarantined, not applied as another policy update.

contradictions_preserved: Exact retrieval identity already exists and human feedback uses it, while model feedback still joins by newest same-session open row.

The current synchronous path reconstructs query/candidate text near Stop time; moving it out of the hook without freezing or digest-binding its exact inputs would repair latency while leaving a causal-input transplant gap.

_apply_credit records generation but explicitly does not enforce a stale-generation fence in this donor phase; deferred Triggerword-4 admission must define currentness rather than infer it from the stored field.
counterhypotheses: If durable_memory rows and transcript turn content are proven immutable for the entire deferred-job lifetime, a full bounded input snapshot may be unnecessary; an immutable content reference plus digest can be sufficient.

The database schema may already enforce uniqueness that prevents two modell:relevanz rows for one retrieval despite value-dependent receipt hashes; that remains UNKNOWN here and should be source-crosschecked before adding a redundant uniqueness mechanism.
A shared DeferredCausalReturnEnvelope may remain unnecessary if RetrievalRelevanceCandidate/v1 can use the same identity law with a simpler subsystem-specific serializer.

required_actions: Reuse existing retrieval_id/turn_id/episode_id/causal_id/generation/query_hash instead of inventing a second retrieval identity.
Emit RetrievalRelevanceCandidate/v1 at origin time with an exact digest/ref for the query plus ordered candidate payload actually sent for judgment.
On completion, exact-lookup retrieval_id and verify turn/causal/generation/query/input digest before any reducer write.
Define stable logical-job idempotency independent of numeric model credit and explicitly handle a conflicting second result.
Execute reversed-completion same-session tests and an input-mutation/transplant adversarial test; relevance must never attach to the wrong retrieval or different candidate bytes.
Keep model-derived relevance noncanonical and preserve deterministic Stop bookkeeping independently of model latency/failure.

next_exact_gate: Triggerword-4 external/non-provider lane: implement RetrievalRelevanceCandidate/v1 by reusing the existing retrieval envelope, bind the exact query/candidate input digest at dispatch, and prove reverse-order overlap plus input-mutation/transplant rejection while later deterministic Stop bookkeeping remains complete.
